name: Bavarian Pretzel
tagline: Hand-twisted the traditional way and baked to a deep golden brown.
description: Our Bavarian pretzel is hand-twisted every morning, given a traditional lye bath for that unmistakable mahogany crust, then finished with coarse sea salt straight out of the oven. Chewy on the outside, soft and pillowy within.

name: Butter Croissant
tagline: Buttery, airy and laminated to a perfect flaky crumb.
description: Laminated over three days with cultured French butter, our croissant proofs slowly for a honeycomb crumb and a crust that shatters at first bite. No shortcuts, no shortening.

name: Classic Berliner
tagline: Soft, pillowy and filled with the finest fruit preserve.
description: A cloud-soft yeasted dough, fried to a blush-gold finish, dusted with powdered sugar and piped full of our house-made sour cherry preserve. A jam pocket in every bite.

name: Sourdough Country Loaf
tagline: 72-hour fermented, blistered crust, open honeycomb crumb.
description: Built on a 12-year-old starter and fermented for 72 hours, this loaf carries a gentle tang, a deeply blistered crust, and a crumb open enough to catch every drop of butter.

name: Cinnamon Swirl Roll
tagline: Rolled thick with cassia cinnamon, glazed while warm.
description: Brown-butter dough rolled with Ceylon-cassia cinnamon sugar, baked until the centre stays soft, and finished with a cream-cheese glaze poured on while it's still warm from the oven.

name: Chocolate Chunk Cookie
tagline: Brown-butter dough loaded with dark chocolate chunks.
description: A 48-hour rested dough for deeper flavour, brown butter for nuttiness, and generous chunks of 70% dark chocolate. Crisp edges, a soft molten centre.

name: Almond Croissant
tagline: Double-baked and filled with silky almond frangipane.
description: Yesterday's croissant, dipped in almond syrup, filled and topped with house-made frangipane, then double-baked and finished with toasted flaked almonds and a snow of icing sugar.

name: Rustic Baguette
tagline: Crackling crust, wide open crumb, baked twice daily.
description: A lean, straightforward dough given a long cold proof so the crust shatters and the crumb opens up wide. We bake this one twice a day so it's never more than a few hours old.

name: Hazelnut Praline Cupcake
description: A brown-butter hazelnut sponge under a swirl of praline buttercream, finished with a shard of caramelised hazelnut brittle for crunch.

name: Sea Salt Pretzel Bites
tagline: Bite-sized pretzels, malted crust, flaky sea salt.
description: All the mahogany crust and chew of our full pretzel, twisted small for sharing. Malted, baked, and finished with flaky sea salt while still warm.

name: Seasonal Fruit Tart
tagline: Almond frangipane, vanilla cream, market fruit.
description: A shortcrust shell blind-baked to order, layered with almond frangipane and vanilla pastry cream, and topped with whatever fruit is best at market this week.

name: Vanilla Cream Berliner
tagline: The classic berliner, filled with Tahitian vanilla cream.
description: Same pillow-soft fried dough as our classic berliner, this time piped generously with a slow-cooked Tahitian vanilla pastry cream and dusted with sugar.
